name: Appointlet
tagline: The visible booking links loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Appointlet earns its keep through OAuth, calendar reliability, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Appointlet costs $12/mo ($144/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
